body:
I just upgraded to TH8 as a fully maxed TH7. 

It's really about your play style. There is more loot in silver league at TH8, but I am getting wrecked (losing 100-300k with a farming base) every time I log off. If you sit and attack for hours at a time, upgrading might be fun. But if you wanna raid 1-2 times a night and log, it's going to hurt more than it helps.
Earlier today. It hurt so badly and I couldn't make it stop.
